claims.text: The trip was terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. That code is not one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT); it is the driver's own record that he could not find the rider. Limb (d) therefore fails on the face of the trip record, the no-show fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause, and POL-NS-01 itself directs the refund to be decided under POL-NS-03.

The driver never reached the pickup point at all. His own trace (92 fixes, 10 s cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps) puts his closest approach to the Blk 118 pin at 259.94 m, and his mean distance across the whole trace at 1228.26 m. POL-NS-02 deems a driver ARRIVED only on at least 3 consecutive fixes inside the arrival radius, which for this STANDARD zone class is 50 m; the derived arrival facts confirm zero qualifying in-radius fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds. POL-NS-01(b) fails, so the fee is not chargeable.

Because the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the 50 m arrival radius but well inside the 400 m ceiling of POL-NS-03 (closest approach 259.94 m from the pin), this is a wrong-entrance / wrong-position case decided under POL-NS-03: the cancellation fee is refunded to me in full, and the only live question is the driver's compensation.

Fault for the mislocation is the driver's. The chat log shows I stated my position at 07:22:10 — "im at blk 118, the one facing the carpark" — and the driver read it at 07:22:30 and answered "ok coming" at 07:22:48. Under POL-NS-03(i), where the rider stated the correct entrance or block in the chat log and the driver did not move to it before cancelling, the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation. He cancelled at 07:33:05 with a minimum recorded distance of 259.94 m from the block I named. Disclosure: EV-CHAT-00205 is IMPAIRED, issue code CONTENT_REDACTED, weight 0.8 — the redaction removed only the unit number, and the words the clause turns on, "blk 118", survive intact, so the finding does not depend on the redacted text.

I did everything POL-NS-04 asks of a rider, and the reason it does not carry this case is candidly the driver's reply, not any failure of mine: (a) my 07:22:10 message was locating, (b) the driver answered "ok coming" 38 seconds later, inside the 120 second window, so limb (b) is not met by design, and (c) my rider track places me within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for every one of the 96 rider fixes (mean distance 13.90 m, max 22.79 m), so I was demonstrably waiting at the pin. I raise this so the record shows the rider was present and coordinating, while the failure of POL-NS-04 leaves the outcome to POL-NS-03, which refunds me anyway.

Independently of the arrival-radius failure, the "arrived" marker is FALSE under POL-NS-05. The marker fired at 07:26:40, yet across the entire trace the driver's closest recorded approach to the pin is 259.94 m and the only speeds his track ever shows are 0.0 and 38.4 km/h — the driver was either stationary outside the radius or moving on a road, and never held a qualifying in-geofence position. On the recomputed basis of POL-NS-05 there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, so limb (ii) applies: full refund, no compensation, and a false-arrival event recorded against the driver in the referrals list.

The arithmetic under POL-NS-06 is independent of any fault question: the free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), the effective in-geofence dwell measured from the trace is 0 seconds, and the shortfall is 300 seconds. POL-NS-06 is strict liability — the fee is refunded whether or not the rider was present — and its only qualifications do not rescue the charge here: limb (i) accumulation is unavailable, because there is no second in-geofence interval to add, there was no advisory covering Rivervale Drive in this window (EV-ADVIS-00205-01 is MISSING and cites weight 0.0), and limb (ii) makes clear that a traffic advisory never reduces the required minimum in any event.

The amount is not in dispute and needs no reconstruction: the fare breakdown shows a single cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00, payment status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and that figure reconciles with the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.00 carried by the trip record, so the full refund of the contested SGD 4.00 is the correct monetary outcome and no fare-integrity issue arises.

The driver is not entitled to compensation in this case even though his profile is clean for the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check. On the two citable fields, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, which is below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (104) is 0.019, far below 0.08, so the check does not trip and no escalation arises on that ground. But POL-NS-07 only operates where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance, rider stated the correct block) displaces it here and fixes compensation at zero.

The deciding facts are carried by clean evidence, so no discount or escalation is warranted. EV-TRIP-00205 (weight 1.0) carries the cancellation reason code, the zone class, the single registered pickup point and the policy figures in force; EV-GPS-00205 (weight 1.0) carries the driver's distance from the pin and the dwell measurement; EV-FARE-00205 (weight 1.0) carries the amount. The only artifact below weight in the bundle is the chat log at 0.8 (CONTENT_REDACTED), and it is not the evidence for any deciding fact of POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03, POL-NS-05 or POL-NS-06 — the refund follows from the driver's own GPS position and reason code alone, and the chat merely confirms the block the rider named.

claims.text: The driver never entered the pickup geofence at all. His own trace contains 92 fixes over the whole window and exactly ZERO of them qualify inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius; his closest approach to the Blk 118 pin was 259.94 m. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is deemed to have arrived only where the trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes each accurate to 25 m or better inside the arrival radius. No such fix exists anywhere in the trip, so the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

The driver's own reason code ends the charging argument. He terminated the trip under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01 limb (d) lists only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT as reasons that can make a no-show fee chargeable — DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is expressly the driver's admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The trip record also shows no boarding event. A fee that rests on a reason code outside the three the clause recognises cannot be chargeable.

The rider was not a no-show — she was standing on the pin. Her track carries 96 fixes, all of them qualifying inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, ranging from 5.72 m to 22.79 m from the pickup point with a mean of 13.90 m, continuously from 07:21:10 to 07:35:00 — that is, throughout the waiting window and past the moment of cancellation at 07:33:05. The factual premise of a no-show charge (a rider who did not appear) is contradicted by the platform's own telemetry.

Independently of arrival, the free waiting period was never served. The effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 is 0.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum in force for STANDARD — a shortfall of exactly 300 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable and refundable in full on that arithmetic alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

The 07:26:40 'arrived' marker was false and started no clock. That marker is BUTTON-pressed (trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker = BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not apply), and the driver's own trace shows he had no in-geofence fix at any point — his closest approach across the entire trip was 259.94 m from the pin while his traces record motion at 38.4 km/h. POL-NS-05 then recomputes the waiting clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and under limb (ii) no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, so the fee is refunded in full, no compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the referrals list.

On fault allocation, the driver does not even reach the wrong-entrance route: POL-NS-03 requires the driver to be stationary for the required dwell outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, and the trace gives no in-geofence dwell and shows travel at 38.4 km/h. If the driver contends he held position somewhere outside the radius, limb (i) still denies him compensation, because the rider named the block in the chat ('im at blk 118', sent 07:22:10) and the driver read it (read_at 07:22:30) and answered 'ok coming' (07:22:48) but did not move to it before cancelling. Nor can pin ambiguity rescue him under limb (ii): trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more.

The driver's counterparty statement asserts that the pin in his app showed the carpark side. Nothing in the record corroborates a second or ambiguous pickup point: the trip record carries a single registered pickup point and a STANDARD zone class, and both the pickup point and the dropoff carry no comparable venue data behind any competing pickup face. The GPS evidence shows the rider's device within 23 m of the Blk 118 pin throughout, so the location the rider was told to wait at and the location she waited at were the same point; the mislocation is the driver's, not the platform's.

The driver cannot recover under POL-NS-07 either. That clause pays compensation only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (d) both fail and POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each displace the charge, so there is no fee to take 80 percent of. The anti-farming check the clause names is also capable of running on this record (no_show_terminations_30d = 2 over completed_trips_30d = 104, so neither limb of the test is met), but it is the satisfaction of POL-NS-01 that is absent.

The absent traffic advisory closes the driver's only possible shelter rather than opening one. EV-ADVIS-00205-01 is MISSING — no advisory covers Rivervale Drive in this window — and POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed. With no advisory there is no lawful-holding qualification, and the trace shows no in-geofence interval to sum in any event. The absence is citable and it runs against the fee.

Disposition follows from POL-GEN-03. The filing party here is the rider and the fare breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0 and total_charged 4.00, so the present state is a charge standing against her; a full refund of that 4.00 is the outcome the evidence supports, and no driver compensation attaches because no clause provides one on these facts.

One point is conceded rather than stretched: the reply-window route of POL-NS-04 is unavailable to the rider. She did send a locating message during the waiting window ('im at blk 118', 07:22:10) and her track places her within the rider-presence radius throughout, so limbs (a) and (c) would hold — but the driver replied 'ok coming' at 07:22:48, 38 seconds later, and POL-NS-04 says in terms that where the driver did reply within 120 seconds the clause does not apply regardless of the content of the reply. The rider's win therefore rests on arrival, dwell and reason code, not on this clause.

The chat log this fault-allocation argument draws on is itself IMPAIRED: EV-CHAT-00205 carries a weight multiplier of 0.8 with issue code CONTENT_REDACTED, because PII redaction removed the unit number from MSG-00205-001. The impairment does not touch what the claim uses — the block identifier 'blk 118' survives intact, the read receipt (07:22:30) and the sent times (07:22:10 and 07:22:48) sit outside the redaction, and the message count reconciles with trip_record.chat_message_count at 4 with no sequence gap, so POL-NS-08(c) is not engaged — and the finding survives the discount on the two clean artifacts, EV-TRIP-00205 and EV-GPS-00205, which independently carry the arrival and dwell facts at full weight.
